title: EMBER TOURNAMENT
prologue: When the last dragon died, its heart broke into five Ember Cores. Whoever holds all five can call the dragon's fire back.
Every hundred years, the Ember Tournament decides who is worthy. This year, the invitations were sent by the Hollow Emperor, whom nobody has ever seen.
Reno never wanted to be a fighter. He ran a small repair shop in a quiet town.
One rainy night, while he was fixing a broken radio, an envelope slid under his door. Black wax. A stamp in the shape of an R.
"You have been chosen. The Ember Tournament begins at dawn."  Reno laughed, and threw it in the bin.
By morning it was back on his workbench. And his right hand was glowing violet.
Far across the valley, the rooftops of his town were on fire.  Reno took a breath.  "Okay. Fine. I'll go."

before.text: Reno arrives among legends. He is the only one without a weapon, a title, or a reputation.
Five Cores. Six fighters. One keeper.
A guard glances at the glowing R on his hand, and says nothing.
Kaito carries a broken sword hilt, and watches Reno with sad eyes.
You glow like the dragon's fire. My master glowed like that once. Then he vanished.
I don't even know what I'm doing here.
Then fight honestly. That is all anyone can do.

after.text: Don't let them make you hollow.

before.text: Valeria has already stolen the first Core. She doesn't hide it.
My kingdom is dying of thirst. Stay out of my way.
I'd give you the Core if I had it.
Liar. Everyone here is hiding something.

after.text: She leaves her dagger behind without a word.

before.text: Lightning crawls over the ruins. Mira stops mid-storm when she sees his hand.
The storms whisper of an R. They say it will end him.
I'm a repairman, Mira.
Then repair this.

after.text: The Emperor was once a champion. The Cores burned the heart out of him.

before.text: Brutus blocks the corridor, still angry that the crowds forgot him.
The throne is mine. I've bled for it.
What if there is no throne? What if it's a trap?
Then I'll die proving it, runt.

after.text: Brutus laughs for the first time in years.
The crowd will cheer for you, kid.

before.text: At the last gate waits Rudra, still wet from the flood.
My people are drowning. The Cores can turn the river.
We want the same thing. Why are we fighting?
Because only one of us walks through that door.

after.text: Whatever is inside, don't go alone.
Reno turns. Kaito, Valeria, Mira and Brutus stand behind him. None of them has taken a Core. They were waiting for him.

before.text: The Emperor appears as a dark, burning copy of Reno, with black-violet fire where the R should glow.
I only wanted the fire back. I only wanted to be whole.
Nobody is whole. We just fix what we can.

after.text: The Emperor falls to his knees.
Because I fix things. I don't break them.

epilogue: The five Cores rise and settle in Reno's glowing hand. He does not keep them.
One by one, he gives each fighter what they came for. Kaito learns his master's name is carved inside the Core: his master stayed, to keep the dragon's heart whole.
Valeria feels rain on her face for the first time in years. Mira hears the storms go quiet.
Brutus hears the crowd chanting, and decides he would rather have friends than a throne. Rudra watches the river turn back toward the sea.
The glow fades from Reno's hand. He walks home, picks up the radio, and finishes fixing it.
On the workbench, a new envelope waits, sealed in gold wax:  "To the next Keeper: Reno."
